purpose: Durable chef-facing cover authority for Low Tide Signal. Defines the cover-only trade-dress pixel reference, reference scope, and generation gates without changing the RexPrompt assembler.

authority.coverRecipe: The exact assembled LTS_CNN_COVER RexPrompt recipe controls the issue-specific selling image: focal subject, environment, character use, composition, palette emphasis, thumbnail read, negative space, emotional promise, and spoiler ceiling.
authority.tradeDress: The published Low Tide Signal Issue 1 preview cover controls the recurring cover-line masthead/logotype, title hierarchy, chapter/issue label behavior, recurring brand marks, and trade-dress rhythm at cover scope only.
authority.characterIdentity: Approved recurring-character visual references control identifiable faces, bodies, hair, proportions, and stable wardrobe. The published preview-cover figures are never character-identity authority.
authority.interiorProduction: Cover recipes and the cover reference never control interior page composition, page language, character identity, story geography, or sequential continuity.

tradeDressAnchor.use: Retrieve and inspect the actual image pixels before generating any Low Tide Signal cover. Carry forward the recurring trade-dress system while allowing every chapter recipe to use a different selling composition.

coverRecipes.rule: Important cover instructions must remain in assembler-visible fields. Summary states the selling promise; setting/region/characters supply reusable production ingredients; panelPlan carries composition, focal hierarchy, thumbnail logic, palette emphasis, negative-space plan and spoiler ceiling; dialogueInline carries exact required cover text; directionInline carries cover-specific hard rules and pixel-reference scope.

coverLineDoctrine: Every cover sells one dominant idea rather than summarizing the chapter.

A Low Tide Signal cover should feel like a piece of grounded coastal infrastructure the reader wants to enter, with human drama expressed through scale, practical light, weather, objects, posture and environment.
The sequence may vary dramatically in composition—threshold, architecture, social roof, still life, spectacle, aftermath, spare dawn—while the Issue 1 anchor keeps the line visibly related.
Covers must remain legible at thumbnail size through a simple dominant silhouette/shape system and disciplined value hierarchy.
Spoiler-safe does not mean generic: advertise the loaded pressure, contradiction or desire, but do not visualize the issue's resolution, major reversal or climactic reveal.
No recap collage, generic ensemble lineup, superhero posing, cyberpunk neon, supernatural imagery, lanterns, fake action spectacle, invented blurbs, or decorative promotional clutter.
sessionStartGate: Resolve the requested Low Tide Signal cover production unit and assemble its exact LTS_CNN_COVER recipe.
Retrieve the published Issue 1 cover as actual pixels from the canonical StarSplitterVisions repository and inspect it before generation.
Use the Issue 1 cover only for recurring masthead/logotype/title/chapter-label/trade-dress continuity.
Identify any recurring core character that is visually identifiable in the active cover recipe and retrieve approved character-identity pixels before generation.
Select relevant approved environment/world references when they exist; otherwise use current Low Tide production shelves for environment design.
Use the active cover recipe—not the Issue 1 reference—for the issue-specific selling composition and spoiler ceiling.
Generate only after trade dress, character identity when required, and environment authority are resolved.
postGenerationGate: Thumbnail test: the dominant cover idea remains clear at small size.
Trade-dress test: masthead/logotype/title hierarchy visibly belongs to the same Low Tide Signal line without copying the Issue 1 illustration.
Recipe test: composition, cast, environment, palette emphasis and spoiler ceiling match the assembled cover recipe.
Continuity test: identifiable recurring characters use approved identity references; preview-cover figures are not substituted.
Lettering test: LOW TIDE SIGNAL and the chapter label/title are exact, legible and professionally integrated; no unscripted promotional text appears.
Shelf test: the cover is clearly distinct from the other chapter covers while still belonging to the same series.

anchorPromotionPolicy.current: Use the published Issue 1 preview cover as cover-only trade-dress anchor.
anchorPromotionPolicy.future: If LTS_C01_COVER is generated, explicitly approved, and designated as the production cover-line authority, update this file to point to that approved image as the stronger anchor. Do not silently promote a merely generated draft.
anchorPromotionPolicy.rule: Approval changes authority; recency alone does not.
